column1: # Grounded questions for FasterXML/jackson-databind at commit 2b72ff3.
# This is the first question set for a repository with no framework at all. Petclinic questions
# lean on endpoints, tables, and guards; none of those exist here, so these exercise the plain
# Java model: inheritance, calls, exception flow, and module structure.
# Ground truth was read from the source, not from tool output. A question set derived from what the
# tool already says is a change detector, not a correctness test - it would pass forever while the
# Run with the repository's Maven classpath (resolution is 99.7% with it, 86% without):
# id <TAB> repository <TAB> question <TAB> kind <TAB> subject <TAB> expected names (|) <TAB> expected locations (|) <TAB> min confidence
# Confidence floors: 1.00 compiler binding, 0.98 in-repository symbol, 0.95 single-candidate
# dispatch, 0.90 framework/workflow, 0.60 multi-candidate dispatch, 0.55 explicitly unresolved.
# Library code reaches deep into JDK types whose calls stay unresolved without their sources, so
# traversal questions here floor at 0.55 rather than pretending otherwise.
